text: so the bulbs do not stay attached to the grass and because the grass moves around then you have these static balls just floating in the air.
resolution: Fixed the flower-grass bulbs so they no longer render as static sphere instances. Flower heads now use a dedicated crossed-card geometry routed through the same grass wind shader in both the editor preview and compiled no-JS loader, with a compile test proving flower grass bakes to the winded flower shape instead of spheres.
